Title: [LoB Preview] Predator's Transformation and Updated rules

Messages.Author: Ezekiel...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Updated rules:

Reflex: A minion can play a reflex card to cancel a specified kind of
card played against him as it is played. The minion need not be
untapped or even ready to play the reflex card. The cost of the card,
if any, is paid as normal, even for the reflex usage.

Ousted cards: If you are ousted, all the cards you control are removed
from the game. (Not burned, just removed from the game.)

New Abombwe card: Predator's Transformation

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/images/CardLoB11.jpg

Predator's taint
Action Modifier/Combat
Abombwe
[abo][Reflex] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is
played.
[abo][Modifier] Only usable as the action is announced. +1 stealth,
even if stealth is not yet needed.
[ABO]{Modifier][Combat] Only usable when this vampire burns a minion
controlled by your prey, either in combat or as a (D) action. Your
prey burns two pool. A vampire may play only one Predator's
Transformation at superior each action.

Versatile.

>It's still looks too cornercase to require a new type of card

Bear in mind that LSJ has said that these are intended to be an extra on
the cards that use them.

The amount of text you need to explain what is being cancelled, the
timing of it and who may play it could well get quite large - especially
since the Reflex template doesn't necessarily have to be applied to
combat effects.

At that point, you probably want to limit the amount of text needed so
that the Reflex ability can be short, and the rest of the card can have
more of the card text devoted to it.

Uh, Mask isn't played after action resolution. You can't go 'I bleed
you for 1 with Duck', and wait until after the action has resolved (and
he's already lost the 1 pool) to say 'wait wait, it was really Ozmo and
he Conditions you!' - Mask can be played after block declaration (or
final lack thereof), but it HAS to get played _before_ action
resolution - you can't determine how (or if, like the ability to pay
blood costs for instance) an action resolves if you haven't finalized
who is performing the action.

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:


Very, very incorrect (aside from the card title being Predator's
Transformation, not Taint).

For example:

PT can be played after you Amaranth your opponent's minion during a
combat. This is not a circumstance where you can play Mask of 1000
Faces (to, uh, suddenly say Ozmo was Amaranthing him and not the minion
who actually went through combat?)

Predator's Transformation can be played in/after a combat, and Mask
can't. Therefore, Mask cannot be played anytime Predator's
Transformation [ABO] can.

And even outside of combat: If I take a (D) action to burn my prey's
ally, I cannot play PT at [ABO] until after the action has resolved
(when the minion is burnt). But I can only play Mask _before_ the
action has resolved (although I can wait til the last second before
resolution), because the action can't resolve unless I finalize my
declaration of the acting minion so that things like 'can this acting
minion still pay the cost of the action or not' and the subsequent
actual cost-pay takes place.

For instance, I can't say that Le Dinh Tho is burning an ally with
Release of the Shackled Soul, have him actually pay the blood for the
action (and burn the ally) and THEN Mask it over to Carlotta; she has
to become the acting minion before we get to the point where the action
cost is paid (though she can do so after any block attempts have been
resolved as unsuccessful.)

Basically, Mask is almost NEVER playable when Predator's
Transformation's [ABO] level is.

-John Flournoy

"Only usable by a ready, untapped vampire other than the acting minion
who is capable of performing the action. Not usable if any action
modifiers or other effects have been used that could not have been used
if this vampire were the acting vampire.
[obf] Untap the acting minion and tap this vampire instead. Now this

performing it.
If the action is ended, then there is nothing to resume.
